description: Hit by speeding four-wheeler near Sitabuldi flyover pillar 12. Hind leg bleeding and fracture, unable to stand, sheltered near road divider.
locationText: Near Sitabuldi Metro Station & Flyover Pillar 12, Nagpur

timeline.note: Incident reported by citizen Priya Sharma with live GPS coordinates at Sitabuldi.
Assigned to PFA Nagpur; field responder Amit Meshram dispatched.
Ambulance van en route with splint kit and stretcher.
Status transitioned to "Treatment" by Smita Mire (SSAF Nagpur).

statusNote: Status transitioned to "Treatment" by Smita Mire (SSAF Nagpur).

description: Young feline trapped in market alley behind medical stores near GMC, visible deep puncture wound on flank, unable to walk properly.
locationText: Behind Medical Square Market, Near GMC Hospital Gate, Nagpur

timeline.note: Reported by shopkeeper Gaurav near Medical Square.
Assigned to PFA Nagpur shelter clinic.
Pooja Kulkarni dispatched with cat rescue carrier.
Cat safely secured in carrier and transported to veterinary center.
Wound dressed with antiseptic, antibiotics administered, IV fluids running.

description: Calf collapsed on main carriageway near Ajni Square during morning rush hour, bleeding near shoulder, heavy traffic danger.
locationText: Near Ajni Square Flyover, Wardha Road, Nagpur

timeline.note: Road safety hazard reported with collapsed calf on Wardha Road.
Hydraulic animal ambulance dispatched from PFA Nagpur.
Ambulance team en route with vet assistant.
Calf safely loaded via hydraulic ramp; shifted to sanctuary trauma ward.

description: Pigeon hung upside down from branch due to kite thread (manja) tangled around wings near Shukrawari lake. Weak wing flapping.
locationText: Banyan Tree near Gandhi Sagar Lake (Shukrawari Talao), Mahal, Nagpur

timeline.note: Report received from citizen near Gandhi Sagar.
Assigned to SSAF Nagpur responder Sagar Wankhede with ladder.
Volunteer reached Gandhi Sagar area.
Pigeon safely freed from sharp manja.
Wing wound cleaned with betadine, resting in aviary.
Bird fully recovered flight capability and successfully released.
Status updated by Field Responder to On the Way.
Status updated by Field Responder to Completed.

statusNote: Status updated by Field Responder to Completed.

description: Community indie dog suffering from extreme mange, hair loss, and shivering under a parked bus near Pratap Nagar garden.
locationText: Near Pratap Nagar Ring Road Garden, Nagpur
assignedNgoName: Nagpur Paws Animal Rescue & Care Shelter

timeline.note: Reported with photos of skin infection.
Assigned to Nagpur Paws. Medicated bath and on-site treatment scheduled.

description: Brown stray dog limping severely, unable to put any weight on front right paw after getting struck by auto rickshaw near Mount Road.
locationText: Near Sadar Residency Road, Mount Road Junction, Nagpur
assignedNgoName: Nagpur Paws Animal Rescue & Care Shelter

timeline.note: Case logged by citizen in Sadar. Nearest NGO automatically matched.
Report accepted by NGO response center triage.
Rescue case accepted by field volunteer Sagar Wankhede. Volunteer is dispatched and on the way.

statusNote: Status updated by Field Responder to "On the Way".

description: Litter of 3 newborn kittens found inside a cardboard box near public park gate. Mother nowhere in sight.
locationText: Children Traffic Park Lane, Dharampeth, West Nagpur
assignedNgoName: Nagpur Paws Animal Rescue & Care Shelter

timeline.note: Abandoned kittens reported in Dharampeth.
Nagpur Paws field responder Chetan Raut assigned.
Responder en route.
Kittens collected safely and placed in warm incubator.
Bottle feeding and neonatal observation active.

description: Two-month-old indie puppy fell into uncovered stormwater drain, yelping loudly. Drain depth ~3 feet.
locationText: Manish Nagar Railway Crossing Underpass, South Nagpur

timeline.note: Reported with exact location at Manish Nagar.
Assigned to SSAF Nagpur responder Sagar.
Volunteer reached underpass.
Puppy safely lifted using rescue net.
Cleaned, fed, and checked for internal injuries. Healthy.
Reunited with mother dog in neighborhood.

statusNote: Status updated by Field Responder to Completed.

locationText: Near Seminary Hills Walking Track / Japanese Garden, Nagpur

timeline.note: Wildlife injury reported near Seminary Hills.
PFA Nagpur wildlife ambulance unit dispatched.
Rescue team en route with specialized net and burn kit.
